definitions.explanation: A sensory perception that appears real but is created by the mind, occurring without any actual external stimulus. Can be visual, auditory, or involve other senses.

examples.japanese: {幻覚|げんかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
⟦{高熱|こうねつ}→高熱：14649_kounetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{幻覚|げんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。

⟦{睡眠|すいみん}{不足|ぶそく}→睡眠不足：08690_suiminbusoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{幻覚|げんかく}⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Prolonged sleep deprivation can cause hallucination symptoms.

notes:
FORMS:
{幻|げん} (illusion, phantom) + {覚|かく} (sense, perception)

TYPES:
- ⟦{視覚|しかく}→視覚：02837_shikaku⟧{幻覚|げんかく}: visual hallucination
- ⟦{聴覚|ちょうかく}→聴覚：13911_choukaku⟧{幻覚|げんかく}: auditory hallucination (⟦{幻聴|げんちょう}→幻聴：24916_genchou⟧ is more common for this)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{幻聴|げんちょう}→幻聴：24916_genchou⟧: auditory hallucination (hearing voices)
- ⟦{幻想|げんそう}→幻想：06753_gensou⟧: fantasy, illusion (not pathological)
- ⟦{錯覚|さっかく}→錯覚：06748_sakkaku⟧: optical illusion, misperception

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幻覚|げんかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: to see hallucinations
- {幻覚|げんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to experience hallucinations
- {幻覚|げんかく}⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧: hallucination symptoms
- {幻覚|げんかく}⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧: hallucinogenic effect
